title: popp
description: Physiological data processing tool of FSL

output_basename.description: Output basename for physiological data and timing/triggers (no extensions)
output_basename.title: Output basename

resp_column.description: Specify column number of respiratory input
resp_column.title: Respiratory Column

cardiac_column.description: Specify column number of cardiac input
cardiac_column.title: Cardiac Column

trigger_column.description: Specify column number of trigger input
trigger_column.title: Trigger Column

pulseox_trigger_flag.description: Specify that cardiac data is a trigger
pulseox_trigger_flag.title: Pulseox Trigger Flag

smooth_card.description: Specify smoothing amount for cardiac (in seconds)
smooth_card.title: Cardiac Smoothing Amount

smooth_resp.description: Specify smoothing amount for respiratory (in seconds)
smooth_resp.title: Respiratory Smoothing Amount

high_freq_cutoff.description: High frequency cut off for respiratory filter in Hz (default is 5Hz)
high_freq_cutoff.title: High Frequency Cutoff

low_freq_cutoff.description: Low frequency cut off for respiratory filter in Hz (default is 0.1Hz)
low_freq_cutoff.title: Low Frequency Cutoff

n_thresh_c.description: Neighbourhood exclusion threshold percentile for cardiac (default 60)
n_thresh_c.title: Neighbourhood Threshold for Cardiac

n_thresh_r.description: Neighbourhood exclusion threshold percentile for respiratory (default 80)
n_thresh_r.title: Neighbourhood Threshold for Respiratory

load_card_phase.description: Input cardiac phase for reprocessing (text format)
load_card_phase.title: Load Cardiac Phase

load_resp_phase.description: Input respiratory phase for reprocessing (text format)
load_resp_phase.title: Load Respiratory Phase

start_sample.description: Set sample number of the starting time (t=0)
start_sample.title: Starting Sample

resp_add.description: Comma separated list of times (in sec) to add to respiratory peak list (uses nearest local max)
resp_add.title: Add Respiratory Peaks

resp_del.description: Comma separated list of times (in sec) to delete from respiratory peak list (uses nearest existing peak)
resp_del.title: Delete Respiratory Peaks

card_add.description: Comma separated list of times (in sec) to add to cardiac peak list (uses nearest local max)
card_add.title: Add Cardiac Peaks

card_del.description: Comma separated list of times (in sec) to delete from cardiac peak list (uses nearest existing peak)
card_del.title: Delete Cardiac Peaks
